name: Dead Set
source:
One night, Layla left without a word. And after that, nothing was ever the same again.

Heart-broken and lost, her best friends have nothing but one thought in mind: find Layla and bring her home. But as days pass, they start having doubts. Was she forced to leave or was it a choice of her own?

[From [url=https://leoreth.itch.io/dead-set]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一天晚上，莱拉一言不发地离开了。在那之后，一切都不再一样了。

她最好的朋友心碎又失落，心里只有一个念头：找到莱拉并带她回家。但随着时间的推移，他们开始产生怀疑。她的离开是被迫还是她自己的选择？

[来自[url=https://leoreth.itch.io/dead-set]itch.io[/url]]
